title: Antarctica as the Nordics' main subterranean base

tellings.quote: the principal subterranean submarine location for these Nordics who we discussed in our first conversation is Antarctica.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking in 2025 on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, talks about a group of beings he calls the Nordics, whom he had discussed in an earlier interview. He says their main hidden base, underground and reached by submarine, is in Antarctica. If true, non-human beings would be living in secret at the bottom of the world today.
